setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step melody on the test device: trigs on steps 1 to 4 on pattern degrees 1 to 4 of scale slot 1 (C major), so MIDI 60, 62, 64 and 65 at velocities 127, 117, 107, 97. No Trig params slot is assigned yet, playback is stopped and the norns shows the Device page. Assign slots in two batches; after each Show result, check the last visible CC before continuing.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Open Trig params, press K2 to enter the slot list and turn E3 to CC 1, press K3, then K2. Check the visible list: slot 1 holds CC 1.
steps.title: Batch 1 — assign CC 1 to slot 1

steps.caption: Turn E2 one slot right, press K2, turn E3 to CC 2 and press K3, then K2. Check the visible list: slot 1 holds CC 1 and slot 2 holds CC 2.
steps.title: Batch 1 — assign CC 2 to slot 2

steps.caption: Repeat for slots 3, 4 and 5 (E2 to the next slot, K2, E3 to the next controller, K3, K2). Check the list shows CC 1 through CC 5 in order; slot 5 holds CC 5.
steps.title: Finish batch 1 — slots 3 to 5

steps.caption: Repeat for CC 6 up to CC 10 on slot 10. Check the list shows CC 1 through CC 10 in order; the final slot holds CC 10.
steps.title: Finish batch 2 — slots 6 to 10

steps.caption: Select slot 10 and keep turning E2 right: it stops at slot 10. Hold step 1 (1,4) and turn E3 to set the value to 0. Turn E2 left well past slot 1: it stops at slot 1. Hold step 2 (2,4) and set the value to 1. Tap Play (1,8). Check the strip below: before its note, step 1 sends CC 10 and step 2 sends CC 1. Tap Play again to stop.
steps.title: Check both ends

title: Use the first and last Trig params slots
